verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents creating and customizing many distinct agents, each with an editable Markdown profile, its own skills and persistent memory, and an IM Gateway/Messenger layer (Telegram, Slack, Discord) for placing agents in chat channels. The evidence never shows per-agent model selection, a separate workspace per agent, or explicit routing of particular channels or conversations to particular agents. missing for 10: documented per-agent model configuration, per-agent isolated workspaces, explicit channel-to-agent routing rules, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a power user, I can run multiple distinct agents with their own prompts, models, and workspaces, and route conversations or channels to each
